core_value_prop: Create a first project and be ready to organize work.

itch.target_emotion: I need a place to start organizing this work.
itch.routine_trigger_schedule: Show the empty-state action when the user opens a workspace without projects.
notification_copy_examples: Your workspace is ready when you are.

lazy_thumb.compressed_core_action: Name a project and save it.
lazy_thumb.ergonomic_layout_changes: Keep Save project within reach on small screens.

paved_path.zero_choice_landing_behavior: Offer Create project as the single first action.
preselected_defaults: No template selection before the first save.

variable_reward.reward_of_hunt: Show a relevant next task when the project is ready.
variable_reward.reward_of_tribe: Offer sharing after the user chooses to collaborate.
variable_reward.variability_schedule: Vary suggestions by real project activity.

dead_end_replacements: Done returns to a usable starting point. Create another stays available.
continuous_loop_implementations: Keep the next project action optional after save.

stored_value.reentry_value: Resume with the project and its existing work visible.
stored_value.data_controls: Use the product's project export and delete controls.

implementation_roadmap.feature: Preserve the draft during save failures
implementation_roadmap.success_metric: First saves completed after a recoverable error
implementation_roadmap.hypothesis: Keeping the project name reduces rework during retries.
